register_coco_zeroshot_datasets: import the coco_zeroshot module to register zero-shot COCO dataset splits with Detectron2
get_metadata_for_category_split: call _get_metadata with seen unseen or all to get COCO category metadata for a split
use_categories_seen_list: reference the categories_seen list to get the 49 seen COCO category IDs and names
use_categories_unseen_list: reference the categories_unseen list to get the 17 unseen COCO category IDs and names
register_custom_lvis_splits: import the module to register cc3m and coco caption tag datasets via custom_register_lvis_instances
